name: ExtraColors
description: Represents the extra colors in a presentation. The object can contain up to eight colors, each of which is represented by an red-green-blue (RGB) value.
example:
With ActivePresentation
    Set rect = .Slides(1).Shapes _
        .AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 50, 50, 100, 200)
    rect.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = .ExtraColors(1)
End With

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single color from the specified ExtraColors collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a color to the extra colors available to a presentation, if the color hasn't already been added.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The red-green-blue (RGB) value of the color to be added.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the extra colors in a presentation.
